stories.title: Man charged after sexual assault in Shotton
stories.summary: A man has been charged in connection with a sexual assault in Shotton, North Wales Police said. Sadam Ionita, 35, of Chester Road East, Shotton, is also charged with trespass with intent to commit a sexual offence. The charges relate to an incident in Shotton on Saturday 1 August. stories.title: Nightingale House Hospice to open new charity shop in Connah’s Quay this week
stories.summary: A new charity shop run by Nightingale House Hospice opens in Connah’s Quay at 10am on Friday 7 August. The Nightingales store is at Unit 6, Redhall Precinct, CH5 4TS, on the shopping parade, with free parking outside. It will sell second-hand clothing for women, men and children, along with toys, games, books and bric-a-brac.

stories.title: Shotton: Chester Road resurfacing begins 24 August with night-time convoy working

stories.title: Prestatyn man jailed for four years after faking electric car motorway fault
stories.summary: A Prestatyn man who told police his electric car had malfunctioned and would not stop on the motorway has been jailed for four years and three months.
